boundary.instructions: Is the revised aggregate/process split logically coherent?

criteria.coherent: Business aggregate owns approved decision and one atomic execution fence; private process owns progress/receipts.
criteria.incomplete: A needed cross-owner state is still placed in wrong owner or absent.
criteria.over_split: Execution fence should also be private only.

race.instructions: Does atomic claim close revise-versus-execute and exact-version drift races?

criteria.true: Actual expected revision, approved decision tuple and content hash are pinned; no later revision/rejection can proceed.
criteria.false: A race remains or tuple not complete.

process.instructions: Is this cross-aggregate sequence correctly ordered and complete?

criteria.coherent: Independent plan proposal/review/approval precedes start; accepted opening remains pending; exact actual started chain is terminal.

terminal.instructions: Is the terminal proof chain now sufficient to bind success to the exact claimed rollover and target started period?

criteria.true: It binds approval, exact plan proposal/review/approval and hash, frozen opening intent/admission, period start, calendar authorization/generation, native root/result.

legacy.instructions: Should ProgramNextPeriodCreated remain a selected domain event?

criteria.process_receipt_only: Remove from selected business event emissions; durable process terminal owns actual receipts.
criteria.aggregate_event: Keep aggregate terminal event as well as process receipt.
